name: Drupal Helpers
description: A developer utility library of static helper classes for common Drupal coding tasks.
project_description: Drupal Helpers (druhels) is a small, dependency-free developer utility library. It ships a set of static helper classes under the Drupal\druhels namespace (ArrayHelper, StringHelper, DateHelper, EntityHelper, NodeHelper, TaxonomyHelper, UserHelper, FileHelper, FormHelper, BlockHelper, CommerceHelper, ParagraphHelper, SeoHelper, DrupalHelper) that wrap common, repetitive Drupal coding patterns: reading current route/node/term/entity context, loading and viewing entities, walking taxonomy hierarchies, manipulating arrays and strings, attaching SEO markup, sending mail without hook_mail(), and Commerce cart calculations. It provides no routes, permissions, config, or admin UI; it is a code-only base library consumed by custom modules/themes and by projects like Drupal Improvements. This documents the 2.x development branch (the on-disk info.yml declares no version).
